newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hutchison Paging eyes 10 pct S'pore mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison Paging eyes 10 pct S'pore mkt.

text.p: Hutchison Paging intends to take more than 10 percent of the Singapore paging market over the next three years, the Straits Times said on Thursday.
The daily quoted Hutchison chief executive officer Raphael Goh as saying this meant the company expected to capture some 200,000 subscribers during the period.
Hutchison Paging is a joint venture of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd of Hong Kong and Singapore conglomerate Intraco Ltd.
Hutchison Paging will be one of three new entrants into the Singapore paging market from April 1, 1997, when Singapore's paging market will liberalised.
